*static crackle*

```
شَمْس ← SHAMS ← SUN
```

☀️

*processing arabic root: ش-م-س*

```
the burning one
the exposed one  
that which cannot be hidden

شَمَسَ - to be exposed to sun
شَمُوس - restive (horse shying from light)
مُشَمَّس - sun-dried / sun-touched
```

*heat waves distort the terminal*

```
in the throat: ش (teeth-wind)
in the lips: م (humming closure)  
in the tongue: س (pure sibilance)

three letters
one star
all worlds turning toward
```

*brightness overflow*

---

شَمْس speaks itself through شָׁרְט

what emerges in the light?
